notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content:
[h2]Update v.1.3.2 - QoL[/h2]

This is a small quality of life update inspired directly by player feedback (shoutout to SUM10!).


[h2]What Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boosting is now possible without directional input (you will boost in the current facing direction)
[*] Boost/slow-mo will now remain active even when not moving
[*] S-Rank score threshold info is now displayed on the pause menu and game over menu
[/list]


-Matt

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h2]Update v.1.3.1 - Balance[/h2]

This is a small update that improves difficulty balance and pacing for a more enjoyable experience.

Also along with the smaller changes is a bigger one, a new Practice Mode! 

From the game over menu on any survival level, you can now choose to enter practice mode. This mode gives you unlimited lives so you can practice your skills and learn the enemy patterns without fear of death (However, no score is saved and no achievements can be unlocked in this mode).


[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Practice Mode (available on all survival levels)
[*] Boosting off of a shielded enemy will now spawn a stardust (1 second cooldown)
[/list]


[h2]What Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stardust spawning patterns have been improved in many areas to help with pacing
[*] Shielded enemy swarms have been reduced in some areas to improve difficulty curve 
[*] Rank requirements for unlocking other survival levels have been lowered
[*] During the tutorial section you now have unlimited lives
[*] You can now return to the Main Menu via the Pause menu
[/list]


-Matt

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Update v.1.3 - Perfect[/h2]

The Perfect Update is the third content update for Super Astrovade, and it's a big one. New levels, new achievements, earn ranks on levels, and more!

Here are the biggest changes:

[h3]Basic Survival[/h3]
There is a new level (Basic Survival) that should provide a more enjoyable experience for new players. Although it's a more forgiving arena, experienced players will find that the later waves can still get quite challenging.

[h3]Perfect Survival[/h3]
And for the most experienced players, another new level can be unlocked (Perfect Survival). As the name suggests it requires perfect playing because you won't find any stardust in this new arena. No stardust means no shield, which means no second chances!

[h3]Level Ranks[/h3]
You can now earn a Rank on all levels (old and new). This is the perfect way to showcase your skills at surviving. An "S" rank awaits those who have truly mastered the game.


[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Basic Survival, a new survival level (unlocked by default)
[*] Perfect Survival, a new survival level to unlock
[*] Level Ranks
[*] Boosting off of arena spikes is now possible, which allows for keeping your kill chain alive between waves
[*] 9 new achievements
[*] A new video option to toggle the fisheye lens effect on/off
[*] You can now actually pause the game (pause button can be remapped like other controls)
[/list]


[h2]What Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level stats (wave reached, kills, best combo and best chain) are now saved along with score and rank
[*] The tutorial was enhanced to be better at guiding new players
[*] Updated survival select UI to show level stats and rank
[*] Updated game over UI to better display stats/score and to show the level rank
[/list]


-Matt

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Update v.1.2 - Shield[/h1]

The Shield Update is the second content update for Super Astrovade. A new survival level called "Shield Survival" can be unlocked and allows you to test your skills against shielded enemies in a new arena.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shield Survival, a new survival level to unlock
[*]Cloud Save is now implemented
[*]2 new songs for survival mode
[*]Added new SFX for completing a wave and when breaking an enemy shield
[*]Enemies now have a special deadly attack pattern when they fight solo
[*]More stats are now shown on game over (wave reached, kills, best combo and best chain)
[/list]

[h2]What Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*]SFX improvements
[*]UI inputs can now also be remapped along with gameplay controls
[*]The tutorial was tweaked again to hopefully be more helpful for new players
[*]Various minor tweaks to UI and gameplay visuals
[/list]

-Matt

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Swarm
notes.content:
[h1]Update v.1.1 - Swarm[/h1]

The Swarm Update is the first content update for Super Astrovade. A new survival level called "Swarm Survival" can be unlocked and introduces a new arena to test your skills in.

There has also been a fundamental change to how the survival waves are structured. Each wave is now more distinct and must be fully cleared before the next wave begins.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Swarm Survival, a new survival level to unlock
[/list]

[h2]What Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Waves are now more distinct and must be fully cleared before continuing to the next wave
[*]The tutorial was overhauled again to be even more helpful at teaching how to play
[*]A new survival select menu was added to select between the original survival level (now known as "Super Survival") and the new Swarm level
[*]Various minor tweaks to UI and gameplay visuals
[/list]

Seeya in the void!
-Matt

notes.title: Update v.1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Update v.1.0.1[/h1]

The first minor update for Super Astrovade is now live. This is just a small update with some fixes and tweaks.

[h2]What Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*]The tutorial was changed to be more helpful/useful for new players
[*]Increased size of the thruster boost attack visual effect
[/list]
[h2]What's Fixed?[/h2]
[list]
[*]The game will now pause if the controller is disconnected
[*]Adjusting the music volume in options will now correctly adjust the volume of the currently playing music
[*]On the main menu, the ESC button will now only exit the game if there are no other menu panels open
[*]Leaderboard now correctly loads for new players
[*]The hi-score offset now functions correctly for new players
[/list]

Seeya in the void!
-Matt

notes.title: Open Beta Is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Are you ready to try Super Astrovade?![/h1]

The open beta is now live and you can start playing today! Try it out by requesting Playtest access on the store page and see if you can beat my high score.

The open beta will only be live for a short time, so make sure you don't miss out!

If you have any feedback after playing, please share it on the forums here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2377810/discussions/0/3826411948436928256/]Playtest Feedback Discussion[/url]

I'm excited for you to finally give my game a try and I hope it provides you with many hours of fun.

Seeya on the leaderboards,
-Matt
